notes.title: Version 1.15 Follow the AI team mate.
notes.content:
In the random dungeon player can choose to Lead the team or just follow AI team mates.

Fixed a bug that AI heroes can not pick skill points correctly.
Reduced the damage of two handed weapon skill of Warrior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456771/09f29bef0376e3233efc244c09d2d7659a739ab2.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.14 Large update: Hero Skill Tree
notes.content:
Now there are skill tree system for each hero class.
Each level up the hero will gain one skill point to unlock the skill tree.
First the hero will pick one from two basic specialization, then unlock types of skill tree nodes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456771/640311f2833d0d366c40c84ab5b659c641fdb35e.png[/img]
Warrior: 
1. Defend: Enhance the defence, unlock the revenge blow which is triggered by successful block/
2. Combat: Enhance two-handed weapon skill, light attack will use two handed weapon.
Ultra Master: Lucky attack can have the same chance to trigger its accoriding lucky attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456771/071ab1c53980aba7bb1d9a89d02a291878eb133a.png[/img]
Rogue:
1. Assassinate: Enhance the close combat, trigger assasination to normal enemy target on when performing lucky attack.
2. Archery; Enhance the archery skill, launch fire arrow both in normal attack and bow abilities.
Ultra Master: Super Attack will trigger both 2 types of lucky attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456771/7fc7bf93c00344f82327c2f23aca3700b7bb5cbe.png[/img]
Mage:
1. Frost Mastery: Enhance the frost abilities, each 4 light attacks will provide one level of Mana Storm: Frost to the hero, at max 3 levels, which will upgrade the light attacks. Any damage the hero get will rest the effect.
2. FireMastery: Enhance the fireabilities, each 4 light attacks will provide one level of Mana Storm: Fireto the hero, at max 3 levels, which will upgrade the light attacks. Any damage the hero get will rest the effect.
Ultra Master: Super Attack will lauch additional fire balls and frost arrows to attack enemies around.

notes.title: Version 1.13 AI Improvement
notes.content:
AI now can correctly perform luck attack.
Fixed a bug that rogue can perform assasinate correctly.

Fixed a bug that Tailer House icon lost.

notes.title: Version 1.10 Huge Update: Home City System
notes.content:
[h1]Home City System[/h1]

Players can build and upgrade their homecity. Upgraded homecity will increase magic found, gold and exp gain rate. Increase the equipment of AI Teammate, and unlock Epic and Legendary heroes.

Upgraded blacksmith or tailer house will also provide higher level equipments.

The home city contains 3 major zone.

[h2]1. Warrior Zone[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456771/e7257e4e62cf4024069bccb7e131d57abc8112d3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456771/b83808630432e6719faeb9bc3ab30ac2903ef6e3.png[/img][/url]
[b]Warrior Trainingyard[/b]
Max level 5
Hire strength and agility heroes, will lock epic hero at level 4 and legendary hero at level 5
Upgrade each level will Increase 25% magic item found, gold and experience gain rate.

[b]Armor Smith[/b]
Provide armors for strength and agility heroes, will lock epic item at level 4 and legendary item at level 5.

[b]Weapon Smith[/b]
Max level 5
Provide weapons for all heroes, will lock epic item at level 4 and legendary item at level 5.
[i]Upgrade each level will Increase 25% magic item found, gold and experience gain rate.[/i]

[b]Acdemy[/b]
Max level 5
Hire intelligence heroes, will lock epic hero at level 4 and legendary hero at level 5.

[b]Garden[/b]
Max level 5
Provide healers, upgrade it will increase the heal power and HP of healers.
Upcoming Features: Unlock new healers.

[b]Tailer House[/b]
Max level 5
Provide armors intelligence heroes, will lock epic item at level 4 and legendary item at level 5.

[h2]3. Market Zone[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456771/92b4ff17263b89f8ed1cf2b4c61ee853d42f3d78.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456771/dd10f82032856517427e2874824450da16286cd9.png[/img][/url]
Max level 5
Upgrade each level will Increase 25% magic item found, gold and experience gain rate.
[i]Upcoming Features: Achemy Lab, Guild Hall and Arena.[/i]

notes.title: Upgrade Version 1.01
notes.content:
1. Adjusted the camera's height and distance, and you can now use the mouse scroll wheel to adjust the zoom, increasing game comfort.
2. Fixed the issue of NPCs floating in the main city.
3. Added footsteps sounds for player characters.
4. Fixed the problem of mouse control direction being unresponsive.
5. Fixed an issue where mages couldn't use normal attacks in melee range.
Introduced an aggro system, making monsters and bosses actively attack tank-class professions.
6. Fixed certain areas in the main city that caused characters to become stuck and unable to move.

notes.title: "Dungeon Tale" is released.
notes.content:
[b]"Dungeon Tale" is a single-player ARPG game developed by me alone. It incorporates various elements of traditional ARPGs and combines characteristics of action games and traditional arcade games.[/b]

Players can assume the roles of different races and professions, embarking on adventures in randomly generated dungeons with AI-generated companions. They will complete various boss challenges, level up, and acquire equipment. 

Moreover, in terms of combat skills and actions, the game draws inspiration from action games. For instance, light attacks can be combined with medium and heavy attacks to form combos, unleashing different skills. 

The game's mechanics incorporate features from side-scrolling arcade action games of the 1990s into the 21st-century dungeon exploration ARPG genre. Players have limited revives in dungeons and can collect treasure for score increases, which, in turn, enhance the quality of the final reward chest. Boss battles come with time limits, and the more time remains when the boss is defeated, the more experience points are gained for the final chest, just like the games I used to play in arcades during my childhood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456771/a3ac45d57a0f53924e73f494de04332355e29364.png[/img]

[h2]Game Modes: [/h2]
[b]1. Random Team Dungeons[/b]
Players form a four-person team with AI allies to explore random dungeons, defeat enemies and bosses, and loot treasures. The dungeon is divided into three parts, with basic bosses in the first two parts. In the third part, the player's team joins a 12-player large group to challenge a world boss. In addition to the equipment obtained in the dungeon, players receive chest rewards in the main city based on their performance after completing the entire dungeon.

[b]2. Survival Challenge (Normal/Boss)[/b]
Players and AI teammates enter an arena to defend against waves of enemy attacks. Each hero has only one life, and once the challenge is successfully completed, the corresponding chest will be unlocked. The survival challenge comes in two types: Normal and Boss. In the Boss challenge, the player's team must consecutively defeat five dungeon bosses within a set time limit, with no rest or recovery time in between.

[h2]Races:[/h2]

[b]Human[/b]: Increased stunning ability by 20% on attacks.
[b]High Elve[/b]: Raised energy limit by 33%.
[b]Barbarian[/b]: Reduced rage consumption for super special moves by 10%.

[h2]Classes:[/h2]

[b]Warrior[/b]: Equip single-handed weapons and shields, forming defensive combos while switching to a two-handed weapon for massive damage at critical moments.
[b]Rogue[/b]: Proficient with dual-wielded melee weapons and a backup bow, switching freely between long-range and close-range combat. Special super move combos allow for assassinations on regular enemies.
[b]Mage[/b]: Excel in ranged combat, using lightning, fire, and frost spells to attack enemies in different combo combinations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456771/89beae443525e363808d05ac82cde6e4762d6383.png[/img]

[h2]Future Updates:[/h2]

The game will receive ongoing free updates, introducing new races, classes, dungeon environments, and various gameplay experiences.

[b]Q4 2023:[/b]

Bug fixes and detail optimizations, more dungeon scenarios, and additional game content.

[b]New Class - Paladin:[/b]

Despite the traditional RPG similarities in equipment and combat between paladins and warriors, I hope to make some changes. For instance, while still retaining two-handed weapons, I might change one-handed melee weapons to longer-reaching spears, allowing paladins to maintain an appropriate distance from enemies.

[b]Heroic Dungeons:[/b]

I don't plan to just increase monster levels and equipment drops in heroic dungeons; I hope to introduce more engaging gameplay mechanics. One creative idea is that during battles in heroic dungeons, a colossal corrupted sword will drop onto the battlefield, stabbing into the ground and continuously inflicting AOE damage to all heroes. This raises the requirements for player equipment. Once the corruption ends, players of any class can pick up this artifact and deal tremendous damage to enemies. However, the artifact has a limited number of attacks and will disappear after use. This concept draws inspiration from arcade games of the 1990s.

[b]Q1 2024:[/b]

[b]A New Mysterious Race[/b]

[b]New Class - Demon Hunter:[/b]

Demon Hunters will possess a unique combat style. Unlike traditional dual-wielded weapons, they wear lightweight cloth armor, move swiftly, and carry a specialized blade. This blade remains in its sheath for the most part, storing power and awaiting the perfect moment to strike for a lethal blow. This system is still in the design phase and promises to bring even more unique gameplay to the game. Stay tuned.
